Package dev.px.core.account

Class Session

java.lang.Object
dev.px.core.account.Session
public final class Session extends Object
The result of a successful login, ready to be applied to the running game.

Core never applies it: swapping the session in place is version-specific, so that is AuthProvider.apply(dev.px.core.account.Session). This type only carries the values across the boundary.

The access token is held in memory only. It is deliberately excluded from toString() so it cannot reach a log file.
